Because of the wind coming from the cool ocean the temperatures here are on average a perfect 29° during the day and 25° at night. With steady wind blowing between 20-35 knots. Making it a perfect uncrowded place to learn kitesurfing, &nbsp;new tricks and work on your wakestyle skills.</span></p><p style="margin:0"><span>Bar al Hikman is a 5 hour drive from Muscat airport and a 3 hour drive from Duqm airport or from Masirah.&nbsp;</span></p></div></div></div></div></div></section>  </div></div></div><div id="de248b19-26b7-4147-b544-6dc0c8c7e2f6"><div data-ux="Widget" role="region" id="de248b19-26b7-4147-b544-6dc0c8c7e2f6"><div> <section data-ux="Section"><div data-ux="Container"><div data-ux="Block"><div data-ux="Video"><div data-ux="Block"><div data-ux="EmbedContainer"><iframe data-ux="Embed" allowfullscreen="" type="text/html" frameBorder="0" src="https://youtube.com/embed/zRECJPzkRKU?rel=0&amp;showinfo=0&amp;start=0&amp;autoplay=0&amp;loop=0&amp;muted=0&amp;controls=1" data-aid="CONTENT_VIDEO_RENDERED"></iframe></div></div></div></div><div data-ux="Grid"><div data-ux="GridCell"><div data-ux="ContentBasic"><h4 role="heading" aria-level="4" data-ux="ContentHeading" data-aid="CONTENT_MEDIA_HEADLINE1_RENDERED">Shrimpies</h4><div data-ux="ContentText" alignment="center" data-aid="CONTENT_MEDIA_DESCRIPTION1_RENDERED"><p style="margin:0"><span>Introducing Shrimpies, a secret spot with beautiful waves 2 hours south of Bar al Hikman, perfect for surfing, wave kiting, twintip kiting and SUP-Ing. data-aid="CONTENT_WELCOME_DESCRIPTION_RENDERED"><p style="margin:0"><span>We know sometimes mother nature can be unpredictable and tough on us, so for those non-windy days we got you covered.
